name: Suspicious Borscht
desc: A vibrant red soup dish. Everything about this dish feels half-hearted, looking as if someone simply dumped the leftover ingredients from a previous meal into the pot. Finishing it does make you feel somewhat warmer than before, but it is like a single match being struck, bringing nothing more than a fleeting moment of warmth.

value.text: Slightly decreases the rate of Sheer Cold accumulation for all party members for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
